## About
Greenlight Auto Care is a family-owned and operated shop on Clairemont Mesa Blvd in San Diego. Whether you own an import or domestic car, bring it to us for scheduled maintenance, crucial technical repairs or a simple oil change.
Jerry Sample, Jr. is an ASE Master Technician. He was originally factory-trained on Honda and Acura, but he'll tackle any car. Ask him what's wrong and he'll walk you through it, often with drawings and diagrams. He's not afraid of challenging cars. He thrives on it.
We're committed to auto repair and to serving you with honesty, quality and value. We hold a 4.9 rating from 71 Google reviews.

## Services
- Preventative Maintenance: It's the convenient way to keep your car healthy and extend the life of your car or truck.
- Oil Change: From a simple oil change to oil and filter service, we'll take care of the basics.
- Timing Belt: One customer had the timing belt, water pump and tensioner done on a Toyota Tundra and said the engine runs smoother and quieter than before.
- Battery Replacement: When one customer's car had trouble starting, Jerry found it needed a new battery, fit them in on short notice and followed up afterward.
- Check Engine Light: We track down what's behind the light and tell you plainly what it means.
- Complete Computer Diagnostics: We use the latest diagnostic technology to find the problem and get you a quick turnaround.
- Air Conditioning Service: Air conditioning checks and service for your car or truck.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on my car?
A: We work on import and domestic cars, including Honda, Acura, Toyota, Lexus, Mazda, Kia, Hyundai, Infiniti and Scion. If you don't see yours listed, give us a call.

Q: Can I text my questions?
A: Yes. You can text Jerry directly at 619-587-2131.

Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: How long does it take to hear back from the contact form?
A: Include the year, make and model of your car, and please allow 24-48 hours for a reply. For anything sooner, call the shop.

## What customers say

I brought my own battery, and they didn’t give me a hard time about it at all. They got me in and out fast, basically within 30 minutes, and the actual battery swap took about 20 minutes.

The labor charge was very reasonable, the process was easy, and nobody tried to upsell me or complicate what should have been a straightforward job. While I was waiting, I overheard the front desk talking with regular customers, and it honestly had the feel of a family shop where people know and trust them.

Even though I’m not driving a Honda or Acura, I’d be happy to come back. Good service, fair price, and a no-nonsense experience." (Austin G, 5/5)

The whole system feels tight and properly dialed in.

If you’re maintaining a Tundra and need major service done right, this experience gave me a lot of confidence in the longevity of my truck. Everything feels solid, reliable, and ready for the long haul." (Alexander Knipper, 5/5)
